name: HubSpot Inbox / Help Desk
verified_note: Template. Run the verify flow once per workspace; HubSpot A/B tests markup, so prefer role/text locators over CSS.
quirks: Reply composer is contenteditable; fill may not dispatch input events — type instead.
Conversations can be email, chat or WhatsApp; check the channel before promising a response time.
Deal stage and amount live on the deal record, not the conversation.
Some inbox views paginate; a missing thread may be on page 2.
auth: Browse MCP reuses the logged-in Chrome profile. Never store HubSpot cookies or private app tokens here.

verify: for each selector above: browse.eval document.querySelectorAll(...).length and record which ones return 0
update this file with what actually matched; set verified to the date
read_thread: open the conversation row containing the contact name
snapshot the conversation pane; capture subject, every message, timestamps, owner, associated deal
record the HubSpot thread id from the URL so later actions target the same conversation
send_reply: click the reply composer, browse.type the approved reply (fill does not work on contenteditable in every HubSpot build)
click Send, then wait_for the message text to appear in the thread
set_stage: change the deal stage only for stages allowed in PLAYBOOK.md

guardrails: HubSpot conversations can be email, chat, or WhatsApp — check the channel chip before promising a response time.
Do not edit contact properties that marketing automation owns (lifecycle stage, lead score).
Deal amounts are human-owned; read them into context but never edit.
